sections.Profile:
The "Circus" pinball machine, released by Gottlieb in June 1980, features a wide body design, alphanumeric displays, and can accommodate up to 4 players. It is known for its unique gameplay mechanics, including five flippers but no ramps or multiball options.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1980
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Good Times, Carnival, Circus, Solid State, 1980s
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Ed Krynski
- Art: Gordon Morison
